metadata.name: abyss_bridge
metadata.description: Abyss Bridge — MagicBlock ER/VRF/PER glass-bridge game (see SPEC.md)

accounts.name: owner
docs: PlayerState.owner inside the handler.

accounts.name: permission
docs: Permission Program); the address is validated in the handler
and the account is created by the CPI.

accounts.name: buffer_permission
docs: Permission Program, the permission account's owner program).

accounts.name: delegation_record_permission
docs: the Delegation Program).

accounts.name: delegation_metadata_permission
docs: permission] under the Delegation Program).

accounts.name: validator
docs: every other account is delegated to (same-validator rule).

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: queues inside the handler.

accounts.name: rush_bridge_sec
docs: The Rush bridge secret, so a fall can flag its VRF reseed when
the fall triggers Resurrection Rush. Optional: when the player
is ON the Rush bridge (diff == 3) this is the same account as
bridge_sec, and Anchor rejects duplicate mutable accounts —
clients pass None there (the trigger only fires on falls in
modes 0..2 anyway).

accounts.name: rush_bridge_pub
docs: Public mirror of the Rush bridge, kept in sync with
rush_bridge_sec (Batch 2 patch). Optional for the same
duplicate-account reason as rush_bridge_sec.

types.name: BridgePublic
docs: Public board state (frontend-subscribable). Seeds:
`["bridge_pub", &[diff]]`.

fields.name: vrf_pending
docs: Mirror of BridgeSecret.vrf_pending (Batch 2 micro-patch): the
frontend must NEVER read BridgeSecret (PER will lock it in
Batch 3), so the shuffle state is published here. BridgeSecret
remains the contract-side source of truth; every write path
updates both.

fields.name: revealed_safe_col
docs: Per-row revealed safe column; 255 = hidden.

fields.name: broken_mask
docs: Per-row bitmask of broken (trap) columns.

types.name: BridgeSecret
docs: Hidden safe-tile answers. PER/TEE-locked in Batch 3. Seeds:
`["bridge_sec", &[diff]]`.

types.name: GlobalEconomy
docs: Shared economy ledger, delegated to the ER once and resident there.
Seeds: `["economy"]`.

types.name: PlayerState
docs: Per-player state, the only account that travels L1 <-> ER.
Seeds: `["player", owner]`.

fields.name: balance
docs: Internal Mock USDC ledger balance (backed by VaultConfig.vault_ata).

fields.name: last_rush_id
docs: Last Rush the player entered.

fields.name: last_rush_best_row
docs: Best rows-completed in that Rush (double-count watermark).

fields.name: rush_claimed_id
docs: Rush id whose reward this player already claimed.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Native session key (Batch 1 rule 1): an ephemeral browser
keypair registered by the owner at deposit time.

types.name: RunnerSlot
docs: Lightweight visual snapshot of one runner on a bridge.

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: L1 protocol configuration. Seeds: `["vault_cfg"]`.
